description: Every term retained in the subterm-closed finite set evaluates in the specified structure to its own class.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.model_term_value.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] (S : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.GroundTerm L))
  (E : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.TermPair L)) (hE : E ⊆ S.product S)
  (hS : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.SubtermClosed S)
  (t : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.GroundTerm L) (ht : t ∈ S) :
  FirstOrder.Language.Term.realize Empty.elim t = Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.classOf S E hE t ht
